Fulfillment: Every fiftieth year, trumpets sounded across the land: debts were released, slaves went free, and family land returned to its original owners. Standing in the Nazareth synagogue, Jesus read Isaiah's Jubilee promise, 'to proclaim freedom for the prisoners and good news to the poor,' and announced, 'Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.'
Explanation: Jubilee taught Israel that the land, the people, and even time itself belong to God, and that His economy runs on release rather than accumulation. In Christ, the greater Jubilee has dawned: sins forgiven, captives freed, and an eternal inheritance restored that can never be lost again.
